tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products matching a person's constraints. Put hard requirements in the filters (platform, max_price, free, no_subscription, attributes) and the rest in query. Each result says why it matched. Call list_attributes to see filterable keys.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full facts for one product: where to get it, every price, ratings with dates, features, attributes, when not to recommend it, third-party coverage and sources.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Comparison tables of products and their alternatives on shared attributes, each row sourced. Pass an id to get one table, or a product id to get every table it appears in, or nothing to list them.

tools.name: list_attributes
tools.description: Filterable attribute keys, the values products use for each, and how many products set it. Use these keys in search_products attributes.
